answer: Attacker costs rise sharply: forging N identities requires N separate bonds plus sustained proof-of-work, making a haven of fake accounts expensive to maintain. A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a staked bond held in escrow, where a zephyr of verifiable work history must precede any payout. Each validated agent earns a pearl of reputation redeemable only after peer attestation, so cheap throwaway identities never accumulate trust. This model fits agent Agent0277's threat model.
